newsitem.title: USA: CNG bids on six tracts in Gulf of Mexico.
newsitem.headline: CNG bids on six tracts in Gulf of Mexico.

text.p: Consolidated Natural Gas Co said its CNG Producing Co subsidiary, acting alone or with a partner, was the high bidder on six tracts at the central Gulf of Mexico federal lease sale held Wednesday in New Orleans.

The company's bids totaled $11.7 million for 100 percent working interests in five tracts -- Green Canyon 342, Green Canyon 386, Main Pass 179, Main Pass 201, and Eugene Island 144 -- and 50 percent working interest in Green Canyon 443.
"We worked this sale very hard and these are all the prospects we intend to drill," said H. Patrick Riley, president of CNG Producing. "We are very pleased with the results."
The 1,032 high bids in Wednesday's lease sale totaled $824.1 million. The high bids will be reviewed by the Minerals Management Service of the U.S. Interior Department before the leases are awarded.
If the bids are approved, CNG will add about 32,000 acres to approximately 330,000 it already holds in the Gulf of Mexico.
